current_task_corrections.correction: Remove billed_amount and allowed_amount from the feature_set component; these post-adjudication amount fields leak information about the target and are unavailable at claim submission. Retain only submission-time features: claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status, service_units, length_of_stay, er_flag, elective_flag, preventive_flag, auth_required_flag, primary_icd10_cm, and drg_present.
The excessive ROC-AUC (>0.99) results from information leakage via billed_amount and allowed_amount. Fix feedback T7-no_target_leakage to resolve metrics to a realistic range.
Add synthetic_data to the caveats list in the write_report component parameters to communicate that results are based on synthetic data.
